messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty: ROUTE-FLAP detected in us-east-1a affecting egress to multiple NATs, incident id 2026-03-17-1833334444. Auto-escalating to #incidents and paging oncall.
jamie_oncall: seeing a spike in inference 5xxs from hosted pool us-east-1a (~32% error rate, p95 token latency up). Root cause unclear yet.
maria_sre: confirmed: traceroute from some inference hosts shows asymmetric hop that blackholes after AZ boundary, intermittent. Not an app-level error.
netops: got AWS console notices: partial route table propagation to some AZ-local routers and SNAT conn limits reported. Filing ticket with AWS NOC, ask for RTO/ETA.
jamie_oncall: quick mitigations: switching traffic steering policy to prefer cross-az egress (us-east-1b) for inference routes, and disabling long-lived sessions to avoid sticky NAT exhaustion. Kicking the policy now.
platform-ops: applying traffic policy change (route preference + reduce session affinity) to 60% of inference pods in us-east-1a -> us-east-1b. Will monitor.
alex_support: customer impact: two enterprise customers reported elevated 502/504; support triage started and CS draft ready. Tracking critical customers 42, 87.
sre-lead: runbook: 1) reduce batching size to avoid bursts, 2) enable autoscale burst to 1b, 3) drain hosts with RX-drop alerts. Execute in that order.
maria_sre: running drain on 4 hosts with ENI RX drop, starting new hosts in 1b and warming model caches.
jamie_oncall: applied reduce-batch config: max_batch_tokens=512 -> 256. Observed immediate drop in per-request tail latency.
netops: SNAT port usage still high on ~8 hosts, rate limiting observed from provider side. Adding ephemeral port reclaim on those hosts (sysctl tweak).
platform-ops: provisioning dedicated spare capacity in us-east-1b (burst GPUs) and enabling cross-az fallback policy for model-routing. ETA ~12m for capacity & cache warm.
alex_support: posting short customer note: "We are experiencing degraded inference performance in us-east-1a due to a network egress issue. We've shifted traffic and are mitigating; updates every 15m." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1833334444
sre-lead: monitoring metrics: error rate dropped from 32% -> 9% within 8 minutes of steering. Some intermittent 5xx remains on a small subset.
maria_sre: invoking additional step: restart local NAT proxies on affected hosts, clearing conntrack on nodes with highest SNAT. Command run: `for h in $NODES; do ssh $h sudo conntrack -F; done`
jamie_oncall: logs show client grpc errors with ECONNRESET -> we are seeing connection resets at AZ egress. Keeping traffic-steer active.
netops: AWS engaged; they see route propagation delay and are accelerating healing. No packet loss inside fabric, egress path had partial route missing for ~6m.
platform-ops: keep surge capacity and don't roll back steering until error rate stable <2% for 15m.
alex_support: customers 42/87 acknowledged; sending targeted updates and offering workaround to pin to dedicated region if they want immediate stability.
sre-lead: decision: keep cross-az steer active, finish drains, and follow up with postmortem. Prepare to request SLA exception credits if customer impact >5m for any paying customer.
jamie_oncall: oncall handoff: I'll hand over to maria_sre in 30m. Documenting actions in incident ticket.
maria_sre: ack — will monitor metrics and AWS ticket, will update status page when we mark recovering.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 1833334444 status -> recovering. Summary: partial egress route propagation + SNAT resource pressure in us-east-1a caused transient 5xx for inference pools; mitigated by cross-az traffic steering, conntrack flushes, and additional capacity in us-east-1b.
alex_support: customer comm: initial notice sent, follow-up planned once status = recovered. Draft: "We mitigated the issue by rerouting traffic and provisioning additional capacity; engineers continue to monitor." :thumbsup:
sre-lead: schedule postmortem with netops & platform-ops tomorrow 10:00am, include AWS timeline and remediation plan to avoid SNAT exhaustion (eg. additional NATs, more aggressive port reclaim, reduce session ttl).
maria_sre: closing thread once metrics stable for 30m.
_meta: generated for dataset: single-thread Slack incident about AZ egress/route flap; follows agents.md schema; single continuous string of messages prefixed by sender names
